episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor confronts Leo F. Drummond in a medical malpractice case.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Rudy and Deck have a tense encounter with a witness and make a crucial discovery about their client.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Rudy and Deck search for a missing nurse, their investigation suggests a dark conspiracy at play.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: When Sarah reveals a detail about the case, Rudy must choose between his client and girlfriend.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Worried about Melvin's threat, Rudy defies Bruiser and risks his job and future as Dot's attorney.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Rudy continues to defend his client; Sarah faces new temptations in London with Leo and Brad.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: When Rudy gets arrested for murder, Bruiser agrees to represent him.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Rudy and Deck tail Melvin Pritcher, igniting a thrilling chain of events.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Rudy must decide whether to make an argument he can win or to expose the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Up against Sarah, Rudy wonders if she's still the woman he once knew and loved.
